releases.body:
- The plugin no longer switches itself off when `OPENCODE_SUPERVISED=1`. That marker came from a private launcher that has been removed.
- The compaction note now reads "The durable task snapshot for this exact OpenCode session …" (it used to say "The ordinary workflow's …").

No other behavior change. Tested against OpenCode 1.18.35.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-durable-task-state/v/0.1.3
